solution:
**Note:** Options C and D are printed the same, and both are correct. The answer shown follows the paper's key, C.

Sodium nitroprusside, \(Na_{2}[Fe(CN)_{5}NO]\), is the standard reagent for the sulphide ion in the sodium carbonate extract. Sulphide adds to the coordinated nitrosyl group to give the purple-violet complex \(Na_{4}[Fe(CN)_{5}NOS]\): \(S^{2-} + [Fe(CN)_{5}NO]^{2-} \rightarrow [Fe(CN)_{5}NOS]^{4-}\). The purple colour therefore indicates the presence of sulphide ion.
